data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Facebook App Events and Meta's ad attribution SDK
data.what_it_does: Allows tracking app events and measuring user engagement or ad performance using Meta's SDK. Supports logging custom events, handling consent initialization, and managing event metadata collection.
use_when: You need to measure Facebook ad performance and conversions in your app
You want to build custom audiences for Meta ad targeting based on app usage
avoid_when: Your app does not use Meta/Facebook advertising tools or app measurement
You prefer an alternative independent analytics provider like Sentry
strengths: Mirrors the native iOS and Android Facebook SDK App Events surface 1:1
Supports both CocoaPods and Swift Package Manager on iOS
Supports deferred SDK initialization for user consent management
weaknesses: Requires manual native platform configuration in AndroidManifest.xml and Info.plist
Android inbound URL metadata collection can occur at process start before explicit consent unless explicitly opted out in the manifest
data.setup_notes: Requires creating a Facebook app, obtaining an App ID and Client Token, and modifying AndroidManifest.xml and iOS Info.plist with URL schemes and metadata.

alternatives.name: sentry_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose Sentry if your primary goal is crash reporting, error tracking, and performance monitoring rather than Facebook ad attribution.
